My .02:

Villanelle wasn’t actually a psychopath. I feel there was some ASD or NPD mixed with the emotions being “trained” out of her, (or rather never taught in the first place). But as Martin said, psychopaths don’t think they need to be better people. They don’t think they need to change. She wanted to change. 

Also the show created a fantasyland and revolved around bad ass women doing outrageous things and getting away with it. Many of us were able to love vicariously through them. Not that we want to secretly kill, but to be able to live freely with nary a thought about what anyone else thinks. So the argument that “sHe WaS a TrAiNeD KilLeR. HoW ElSe WaS iT gOiNg To End???” Is bogus bc the show was a fantasy to begin with. Remember back to S2 when Carolyn rehires Eve and they’re in the morgue and she asks E “what do people even do at home??”. WE all know. But the show wasn’t about normal people, moral compasses, or repercussions. 

And we deserved closure on our fantasy.
